posts.instagram_caption:
The Leaf at the Top of the Tree 🍂
A gentle story about waiting, change, and how a bad day is never the end of the story.
He was the proudest leaf on the tallest tree on the hill, until the wind had other ideas. Blown down, picked up, painted, buried and found again, the leaf's life takes one surprising turn after another. Lucky? Unlucky? Who knows?
One to read together now, and to keep for years.
Can you spot the pigeon hiding on every page?
Find it on Amazon: link in bio.
Christmas is coming 🎄 A lovely stocking filler for little ones.
